turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" can mean three things, so here is each for 1-30 September 2026: Signups (new customers) 9, Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) 10, and Customers to date (everyone signed up by 30 September) 30; tell me which one you meant.
